1. PET VISIT — The puppy is more nervous than the older dog. Speak softly near its room.

2. Hi Jo, the red hoodie is warmer than the blouse. Wear it for our outdoor animal visit. Sam

3. ANIMAL CLUB — The new room is bigger than the old one. We can meet inside even when it rains.

4. HAT FOUND — A gold ring was inside a red hat. Ask the teacher if either item is yours.

5. Hi Mum, I finished the pet poster faster today. I have time to help you before dinner. Eva

6. PHOTO RULE — Work more carefully near the glass. Do not put your camera on the edge of the table.
